notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Near-complete. MSUI has the full main action bar: 12 buttons with icon/cooldown swipe+flash/stack count/hotkey (out-of-range red), the three-way usability tint matching ActionButton_UpdateUsable, page up/down arrows + page number (6 pages), spell/item/macro/auto-attack (6603) action kinds, CMSG_SET_ACTION_BUTTON pickup/place, the XP bar with rested state and tooltip, and the performance/latency meter. Cast send/fail, targeting, and rank handling live in Program.Casting.cs / Program.Targeting.cs.
